about.lead: Ever since I started modeling parts, I’ve been fascinated by how design choices play out in physical mechanisms. As a mechanical engineer, I focus on R&D, hands-on prototyping, and CAD modeling.
about.lead2: I also mentor students and working professionals in design tools. I genuinely enjoy the process of seeing an initial concept come together as a fully functional build.
